scripts.setup:ui: npm --prefix packages/ui-kit/quasar ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix packages/crud-kit/quasar ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.test:ui: npm --prefix packages/ui-kit/quasar test && npm --prefix packages/crud-kit/quasar test
scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/ui-kit/quasar run build && npm --prefix packages/crud-kit/quasar run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ui-kit,crud-kit "npm --prefix packages/ui-kit/quasar run dev" "npm --prefix packages/crud-kit/quasar run dev"
